faq.q: Was the North 256 Street Industrial Lands Area Plan really adopted June 23, 2026, as the page says?
faq.a: Yes — that page claim checks out: the City's June 24, 2026 announcement states the Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw creating the plan was adopted on June 23, 2026, formalizing an approximately 500-acre economic hub in northeast Maple Ridge; the plan sets future land use designations and approves no projects itself.

faq.q: When were Maple Ridge property taxes due in 2026, and what are the penalties?
faq.a: Due July 2, 2026 (the first business day in July), with a 5% penalty on outstanding balances from July 3, 2026 and an additional 5% on any balance outstanding on September 2, 2026; an unclaimed home owner grant counts as outstanding.
